import.title: Bring your records over
import.subtitle: Import your clients and animals from a spreadsheet. Nothing is saved until you confirm.

upload.heading: Choose your file
upload.description: Each row should be one animal, with its owner's details on the same row. If an owner has several animals, repeat the owner on each row.
upload.formats: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV · up to 4 MB · up to 2,000 rows
upload.templateBody: Download the template with ready-made headers and two example rows, then type your own records over them.
upload.privacy: Your file is only sent to be read; it is not stored on the server.

map.heading: Match your columns

map.sheet: Read the "{sheet}" sheet. To import another sheet, move it to the front of the file.
map.required: To continue, choose a column for: {fields}.
map.noPhone: No phone column is selected. Existing clients can then only be matched by email; without either, every owner is added as a new client.
map.matched: {count, plural, one {# column matched} other {# columns matched}}

preview.heading: Review and fix

preview.summarySkipped: {count, plural, one {# row will be skipped} other {# rows will be skipped}}
preview.consentBody: A "yes" in a spreadsheet is not consent the client gave you today. Imported clients receive no automatic SMS or WhatsApp until they are asked; you can record their answer on the client page.
preview.existingNote: Existing clients' details are not changed; only their new animals are added.
preview.datesTitle: Some dates can be read two ways

preview.datesEvidence: Of the other dates in the file, {dmy} can only be day/month/year and {mdy} can only be month/day/year.

run.confirmHint: Records are written in one go: either all of them are imported or none are.

template.help1: Each row is one animal. Write the owner's details on that animal's row; if an owner has several animals, repeat the owner on each row.
template.help2: Required columns: Owner full name, Pet name and Species. The others may be left empty.
template.help3: Rows with the same phone number or email are one client; a client already in your records is not added a second time.
template.help4: Write dates as 12.05.2021, in day.month.year order.
template.help5: For species, write names such as Dog, Cat or Bird; you will be asked to match any species that is not recognised before importing.
template.help6: Messaging consent is not imported with this file: imported clients receive no automatic messages until they are asked.
